claims: Selection Sunday for the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's and Women's Basketball Tournaments took place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 68-team men’s bracket was revealed at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The women’s bracket was revealed at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Men's Selection Show was at 6 p.m. ET on CBS, CBS Sports.
Women's Selection Show was at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN, NCAA.com.
Sunday, March 15, 2026 marks the official beginning of March Madness.
